Subject: Request: Security review and artifacts for Redwood pilot

Hi Rachel,

We're getting close to sign-off for the pilot but Security needs a short walkthrough and copies of a few artifacts (SOC 2 summary, network diagrams, and a short answers spreadsheet) before procurement will greenlight the contract. Can we schedule a 45-minute security review this week or early next week? Attendees will include me (security), Lisa (PM), and procurement (I can loop them in once we lock a time).

High-level ask: 30–45 minute session with Redwood security and your AE/SE to cover architecture, data flows, and audit evidence scope. Please indicate available slots (Central Time preferred).

Thanks,
Samir

Lead, Information Security
MeridianCloud

- Fri 11 Sep, 10:00–10:45 AM CT
- Mon 14 Sep, 1:00–1:45 PM CT

Soojin, Ben — are you able to attend any of those? Ben, procurement-level questions are likely; feel free to chime in if you want procurement on the call or prefer doc exchange first.
